newsitem.title: USA: U.S. satisfied with Albanian local elections.
newsitem.headline: U.S. satisfied with Albanian local elections.

text.p: The United States expressed satisfaction Thursday with local elections held this month in Albania but urged the former Stalinist country to develop a new constitution and stage fresh national elections.

"The United States government believes that the Albanian local elections were sufficiently democratic to be accepted as an expression of the will of the people of Albania," State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns said.
Albania's ruling Democrats claimed a landslide victory in the two-part vote Oct. 20 and 27.

Burns said the elections were "a positive step forward for Albania" but urged the country's central electoral commission to address concerns expressed by U.S. and other foreign observers about some irregularities.
"We look to the Albanian government to build on these local elections by establishing an open and inclusive political process and by developing a constitution," he added.
"We urge the Albanian government to follow the adoption of a constitution by holding a popular referendum and parliamentary elections which would be organised under a new constitutional framework."
American and other international observers criticised what they said were serious flaws in national elections in Albania last May and June, in which the Democrats also claimed victory.
